title: AgentTax x402 API — Schema Capture + Invoica Integration Assessment
verdict: ADOPT — free tier sufficient for MVP; x402 per-call path available for production

notes: x402 v2 (not v1) — uses PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (not WWW-Authenticate)
GET /api/v1/calculate returns 402 with full x402 v2 schema — resource cost probe
POST /api/v1/calculate without auth returns 200 in DEMO MODE (50 calls/day, simplified)
POST with X-API-Key returns 200 FULL mode (100 calls/month free account)
POST with X-PAYMENT (x402) returns 200 FULL mode (pay-per-call, $0.001 USDC)
Same asset (USDC on Base) as Clawcard + Invoica settlement rail — zero cross-chain friction
Free 307 redirect from agenttax.io → www.agenttax.io (canonical host is www)

demo_mode_findings.trigger: POST /api/v1/calculate without X-API-Key or X-PAYMENT header
demo_mode_findings.demo_confidence_note: Demo returns confidence.level='partial' even for high-confidence jurisdictions
demo_mode_findings.invoica_implication: NEVER use demo mode in production — missing jurisdiction details + statute citations required for AMD-22 compliance. Detect via response.mode === 'demo' and throw.

criteria.name: x402 v2 Schema Compliance
criteria.description: Is the 402 response a valid x402 v2 schema Kognai can parse with existing infrastructure?
criteria.evidence: PAYMENT-REQUIRED header decodes to clean x402 v2 JSON. Same structure as x402-llm-client.ts already handles: scheme=exact, network=eip155:8453, amount=1000 atomic USDC. Same asset (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913) as Clawcard/Invoica. Zero custom extensions — standard x402 v2.

criteria.name: Transaction Type Coverage
criteria.description: Does the API cover the transaction types Invoica will generate?
criteria.evidence: 15 transaction types confirmed: ai_labor (ERC-8183 spot jobs), api_access (PACT session fees), subscription (BOND recurring mandates), saas (Invoica SaaS), compute (KSL training), data_purchase (DRS data), marketplace_fee (ALX). work_type enum (compute/research/content/consulting/trading) maps exactly to Kognai agent categories. is_b2b flag handles enterprise Deeploy invoices.
risks: Some Kognai transaction types (e.g. 'soul_handshake_fee') may not map cleanly to existing enums
mitigations: Use 'api_access' as default for novel PACT-layer fees until more specific type is added

criteria.name: Response Quality for Invoica Tax Line
criteria.description: Is the response structured enough to populate an Invoica tax_line field?
criteria.evidence: Response includes: sales_tax.amount (USD), sales_tax.rate (as decimal), sales_tax.jurisdiction (state name), sales_tax.note (statutory citation), total_tax (USD), confidence.score (0-100). This is MORE than enough for Invoica tax_line: amount, rate, jurisdiction, statute, confidence. The note field provides the statutory citation (e.g. '80% taxable (§151.351)') which is exactly what AMD-22 requires for compliance.
risks: confidence.score < 70 = 'medium' level — Invoica should flag these for manual review
mitigations: Invoica: if confidence.score < 70, set tax_line.requires_review = true and flag in UI

criteria.name: Nexus Monitoring Integration
criteria.description: Can AgentTax replace manual nexus threshold tracking?
criteria.evidence: Account tier (free: 100/mo) includes nexus alerts via POST/GET /api/v1/nexus. Can configure nexus states + thresholds. Free 100 calls/month is sufficient for Invoica MVP (<100 client invoices). At scale, Growth tier ($99/mo, 100K calls) covers 100K invoices/month — more than enough for Phase 2.
risks: Nexus endpoint requires account tier (not x402 per-call)
Free tier (100 calls) may be hit quickly if Invoica auto-calls on every invoice
mitigations: Cache nexus config per client (don't recalculate same state repeatedly)
Batch nexus checks daily rather than per-invoice for repeat buyers

criteria.name: 1099-DA Export Readiness
criteria.description: Can AgentTax handle IRS Form 1099-DA generation for agent commerce crypto transactions?
criteria.evidence: GET /api/v1/export/1099-da confirmed in API inventory. Requires account tier + trade logging via POST /api/v1/trades. FIFO/LIFO/Specific ID cost basis methods supported. This covers the 1099-DA requirement from AMD-22 / TICKET-017-AGENTTAX-05 without building custom tracking.
risks: Trade logging is manual (POST per trade) — requires Invoica to push each x402 settlement
1099-DA export format not yet tested — unknown if Base USDC settlements are handled
mitigations: Wire POST /api/v1/trades into Invoica afterPayment hook (x402x)
Test 1099-DA export in TICKET-017-AGENTTAX-05 before relying on it for compliance

criteria.name: Cost Model Viability
criteria.description: Is the pricing compatible with Invoica's unit economics?
criteria.evidence: Three paths: (1) x402 per-call $0.001/calc — Invoica passes directly to client as tax_line (zero margin cost), (2) API key free tier 100 calls/month — zero cost for MVP, (3) API key Starter $25/mo for 10K calls — $0.0025/call when bundled. At Invoica's Phase 1 scale (<1K invoices/month), free tier covers everything. x402 path is ideal long-term: Invoica clients pay $0.001 per invoice tax calc, fully traceable on Base.
risks: x402 path requires Kognai agent wallet funded with USDC on Base
No wallet currently provisioned for AgentTax x402 calls
mitigations: Phase 1: use free API key account (100 calls/month)
Phase 2: provision Clawcard virtual card → fund with USDC on Base → x402 per-call
